decision_rule: Spearman(fidelity, harden_gap) < -0.3 AND one-sided p < 0.05 across the 8 instances -> 'transfers to 3D'. Fidelity is frozen from H01/H02: Spearman rank correlation of pairwise centroid distances at compress-end vs the best-known optimum's final arrangement. harden_gap = best harden L - best known L (either method). Also report: harden win rate vs rigid, and per-instance (fidelity, gap, margin).
hypothesis: The scaffold-fidelity rule transfers to 3D: instances where the sphere scaffold lands in the right neighborhood (high fidelity) are where hardening reaches the best-known cube packing; low fidelity predicts a gap. Expected rho < -0.3 on the pooled 8 instances.
note: Numbering: README scoped H03 as public 3D benchmarks; this campaign claims H03 for the 3D fidelity test per the umbrella research plan (2026-10-11). The benchmark track moves to H04.
question: Does the scaffold-fidelity rule transfer to 3D (unit cubes in a cube, spheres -> cubes hardening)?
title: H03: 3D scaffold-fidelity test (cubes in a cube)
